responses.text: Just checking how you’re doing.

responses.text: You sound tired.

barman_alone.text: It’s slow most nights. People drink, talk, leave. I stay.

responses.text: That sounds lonely.
At least it’s peaceful.

barman_reflect.text: Lonely’s just a word. This place keeps me busy enough.

responses.text: Busy doesn’t mean fulfilled.
As long as it works for you.

barman_crack.text: …Maybe. When the bar closes, the noise in my head doesn’t.

responses.text: What does that noise say?
Maybe you just need sleep.

barman_core.text: It says I’m only useful while I’m pouring drinks. After that… I disappear.

responses.text: You don’t disappear when the bar closes.
That’s just part of the job.

barman_mask_off.text: He stops wiping the glass. His shoulders drop.

responses.text: Stay with him in the silence.

barman_ending_mask.text: …Thanks. No one’s said that to me before. Maybe I don’t have to vanish after all.

barman_leave.text: He nods, already reaching for another glass. The bar hums on without you.
